items.difficulty_reason: The lifting property of graded-injective K-injective dg modules: the trick is to replace M' by the direct sum with the acyclic cone on the identity of M so that the map b becomes injective, note the cokernel Q is acyclic, kill the two Hom groups out of Q using K-injectivity, and conclude bijectivity of the Hom map using graded injectivity (Remark why-graded-injective). Retained author proof at lines 4041-4059.
